## Proposed Feature
A clear and concise description of the feature or functionality you would like to see.

## Problem Being Solved
Is your feature request related to a problem or friction point? Please describe (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...").

## Suggested Approach
Describe your proposed solution or how you envision this feature being implemented.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, tools, or workarounds you have considered.

## Acceptance Criteria
List the conditions that must be met for this feature to be considered complete:
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated

## Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, mockups, or relevant references here.
